column3: MT 57:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; אַל־ תַּשְׁחֵת is translated “Set to ‘Do Not Destroy,’” and “destructions” “calamities.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who completes [it] for me” is rendered “who performs all things for me.”
Close to the Hebrew; לֹהֲטִים (“devouring, aflame”) is rendered “Who are set on fire.”
Close to the Hebrew; כְבוֹדִי (“my honor”) is rendered “my glory,” and “lyre” “lute.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” and “faithfulness” are rendered “mercy” and “truth.”
